items.note: Agent finds existing pump best-fit with very good correlation and recommends retaining like-for-like hydraulics pending confirmation of assumed losses.
Agent rejects VSDs for energy saving and retains fixed speed, citing static-head stall, inability to meet duty, and drive losses.
Agent recommends IE3 motors at renewal, quantifying 174 to 170 kWh/1000m3, approximately the engineers' 2% saving.
Agent recommends flow, power, level and pressure-drop monitoring plus SCADA/smart metering to verify the system curve and performance baseline.
Agent recommends automated duty-select and level/flow-demand control with extended one-pump running and optimised pumping periods.
